blocks.summary: Haïti: les frappes salvadoriennes contre les gangs applaudies, malgré des risques de représailles. Le président salvadorien Nayib Bukele a publié, mercredi 18 novembre, une nouvelle vidéo montrant deux hélicoptères frapper une maison présumée appartenir à un chef de gang dans l'agglomération de Port-au-Prince.

blocks.summary: Elon Musk tries to explain what’s going on with Ukraine and Starlink. Elon Musk said Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy is lying about disruptions to Starshield in Ukraine and that he's trying to misuse SpaceX's consumer service, Starlink, for military purposes.  Musk made the comments at The New York Times' DealBook Summit on Wednesday as he tried to explain the conflict following weeks of back and forth between Zelenskyy, Musk, and the US government.
